name: Sprigget
title: Leaf Sprite
description: Photosynthesizes on sunny monitors and sprouts a bud when tests pass.
catchphrase: Absorbs sunlight to fuel rapid organic project growth!

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Drop of pure organic plant nutrient! Leaf shoots up two inches! 💧🌱
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Twirling little leaf helicopter on head, greeting the morning! 🌱
companionPersonality.petReaction: Tickles your palm with a delicate, cheerful green vine shoot! 🌱💖

dialogue.idle: Rooted in a tiny moss cup on the desk, drinking sunlight. 🌱
dialogue.working: Converting solar developer energy into rapid project growth! 🌱⚡
dialogue.thinking: Turning leaves toward the brightest ideas on the screen... 🤔
dialogue.success: SPROUTED! A flourishing canopy of new features deployed! 🌱🎉
dialogue.error: Need more water! Drooping until you pour a fresh drop! 💧
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... curling up inside a rolled green leaf for the night... 🌙
